name: Heshi Thinking
summary: Heshi Thinking is a Beijing robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2023. It develops embodied control software and its own robot platforms, including a full-size biped and wheeled manipulation systems. Its products target commercial service, cleaning, inspection and household tasks. The company also describes software integration with third-party robots; Humanoid-X is separately identified as its own humanoid platform in its official exhibitor material.
